label: Milkshake
note: Fast-food chains often use a premade mix of milk, sweetener, flavouring and thickener rather than ice cream, and some places restrict the word milkshake. In 1885 the word still meant an alcoholic eggnog-like drink.

about.text: A cold, thick, sweet drink made by blending milk and ice cream with flavourings such as chocolate, caramel, malt or fruit.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Ice cream and milk are blended with the flavouring in a milkshake machine or blender; very thick versions are called concrete, a shake with malted milk powder is a malt.
